title: Conformance test harness: CI integration + local runner docs
author: Mateusz Zielinski
description:
Context: As part of the cross-SDK parity audit, we need a conformance harness that can be run in CI and locally in a consistent way. This PR wires the shared scenario runner into the Go SDK repo, adds a GitHub Actions workflow to execute it on PRs, and documents local usage + required env vars.

What this PR does: (1) Adds a `./scripts/conformance.sh` wrapper that runs the Go adapter against the conformance scenarios (supports running a single scenario or suite). (2) Adds a CI workflow `conformance.yml` that runs on pull_request and nightly. The PR job uses a mocked gateway container (429 bursts / 503 flaps / disconnect simulation) and runs the Go adapter in a deterministic mode (fixed seeds, bounded wall-clock). (3) Adds docs: `CONFORMANCE.md` describing prerequisites, env vars (REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_BASE_URL, REDWOOD_CONFORMANCE_MODE), and tips for debugging flaky failures (including capturing request-id from logs). (4) Adds minimal structured logging around retries/timeouts in the adapter (no secrets) to make CI failures actionable.

Notes / decisions: We intentionally do not gate merge on the nightly job (nightly is informational + posts a summary comment). The PR job is required and uses the mocked gateway only; we avoid calling hosted endpoints to keep CI stable and prevent accidental token usage. Timeouts are set aggressively in CI to catch hangs; locally they can be relaxed.

Why now: Go SDK changes for retries/timeouts/streaming are landing in parallel and we need a parity guardrail. This is also a response to recent conformance flakes tracked in INT-441; this PR adds bounded retries within the harness itself (not the SDK) and prints a single concise failure summary.

Testing: `go test ./...`, `./scripts/conformance.sh --suite core` (local), GitHub Actions conformance workflow.

Follow-ups: (a) add additional streaming edge-case scenarios once the shared fixtures are finalized; (b) integrate the same required checks across python/ts repos (tracked in ENG-2485).
commits: ci: add conformance GitHub Actions workflow (PR + nightly)
conformance: add Go adapter wiring + deterministic config
docs: add CONFORMANCE.md (local run + env var requirements)
logs: add redacted structured output for scenario failures
review_conversation:
Ibrahim Khan: Can we ensure the conformance job does not require a real API key? I don’t want accidental hosted calls in CI.
Mateusz Zielinski (author): Yep — updated workflow to spin up the gateway mock container and set REDWOOD_BASE_URL to localhost. REDWOOD_API_KEY is optional in this mode and runner errors if base_url points to production.

Sahana Iyer: Please make the conformance job required for PRs but keep the nightly as non-blocking; also add a summary line to the GitHub Actions step output so failures are easy to spot.
Mateusz: Done. PR workflow is required; nightly is scheduled only and posts a short summary. Also added a final “Scenario failures:” block with the first error + scenario name.

Leila Farouk: The flake mitigation in the harness itself worries me — are we accidentally retrying real assertions? Also, can we cap total runtime?
Mateusz: The only retry is around starting the gateway mock container + waiting for readiness; scenario assertions are not retried. Added a hard 8-minute timeout for the workflow and per-scenario 30s caps.

Rafael Mendes: Nice. Please ensure the logs do not print any Authorization headers or api keys; redaction should be default.
Mateusz: Added a redaction helper used by both the adapter and the failure summarizer. Also ensured we only log request-id / status / error code.

Dana Lo: For cross-SDK parity, can we keep the scenario naming aligned with the shared plan? I see `retry_429_burst` vs `retry/429-burst`.
Mateusz: Updated to match the canonical names from the shared suite; added an alias map for backward compatibility with local runs.

Leila Farouk: Approved after the scenario name alignment + runtime cap.
Sahana Iyer: Approved.
Ibrahim Khan: Approved. Let’s make sure other repos mirror the required check name exactly.
release_notes: Internal: Adds conformance harness runner + CI workflow to prevent Go SDK behavior regressions for auth/retry/timeout/streaming parity.
